name: Cursor
description: Agent status, approvals, profiles, and remaining usage on the evoX deck.

actions.name: Status
actions.description: Shows Idle, Working, or the command waiting for a decision in this user-data directory. Press brings that Cursor forward.

settingsSchema.label: User data directory
settingsSchema.description: Account this key reads. Leave blank for the default Cursor account on this Mac.

settingsSchema.label: Waiting sound
settingsSchema.description: Once plays Glass a single time. Ring repeats Ping until the prompt is answered or it times out.

actions.name: Allow
actions.description: Accepts the waiting prompt, whether Cursor calls it Run, Approve, or Allow.

settingsSchema.label: User data directory
settingsSchema.description: Account this key approves. Leave blank for the default Cursor account on this Mac.

actions.name: Deny
actions.description: Blocks the command or tool waiting in this user-data directory.

settingsSchema.label: User data directory
settingsSchema.description: Account this key denies. Leave blank for the default Cursor account on this Mac.

actions.name: Profile
actions.description: Opens a separate Cursor window using this folder as its user-data directory.

settingsSchema.label: Name
settingsSchema.description: Shown on the key. Leave blank to use the folder name.

settingsSchema.label: User data directory
settingsSchema.description: Folder Cursor should use as --user-data-dir. Each folder is a separate account.

settingsSchema.label: Workspace
settingsSchema.description: Optional project folder to open in that window.

actions.name: Usage
actions.description: Shows how much of the plan is left for the account in this user-data directory.

settingsSchema.label: User data directory
settingsSchema.description: Leave blank for the default Cursor account on this Mac.

actions.name: Stop
actions.description: Sends Escape to the Cursor window for this user-data directory. Needs Accessibility.

settingsSchema.label: User data directory
settingsSchema.description: Account this key stops. Leave blank for the default Cursor account on this Mac.

actions.name: Project
actions.description: Shows the folder the agent has open in this user-data directory. Press brings that window forward.

settingsSchema.label: User data directory
settingsSchema.description: Account this key reads. Leave blank for the default Cursor account on this Mac.

actions.name: Model
actions.description: Shows the model the agent is using. Press steps through the list you set and saves it as the composer model.

settingsSchema.label: User data directory
settingsSchema.description: Account this key reads. Leave blank for the default Cursor account on this Mac.

settingsSchema.label: Models
settingsSchema.description: Comma-separated slugs. Press moves to the next one.

actions.name: Last file
actions.description: Shows the last file the agent edited. Press opens it in this user-data directory.

settingsSchema.label: User data directory
settingsSchema.description: Account this key reads. Leave blank for the default Cursor account on this Mac.

actions.name: New chat
actions.description: Brings that Cursor window forward and sends the new-chat shortcut.

settingsSchema.label: User data directory
settingsSchema.description: Account this key opens. Leave blank for the default Cursor account on this Mac.

settingsSchema.label: Shortcut
settingsSchema.description: Sent after the window is focused. Use the shortcut that starts a new agent chat.

actions.name: Profiles
actions.description: Rotate through the Profile keys on this deck. Press opens the one selected.
